derivation.geometry_scale_reason: the live producer's unsupported-cell grid is fixed at line_width / (6 * infill_density) while its seed count grows with region area, so the fixture's 22 mm x 16 mm regions at 15 % density do not plan in bounded time under the debug profile this recorder runs in; topology and every config scalar are preserved, and the scaled inputs are what the recorded input digest pins
